description: Ô vuông đổi sang màu nhấn trước, rồi dấu tích được vẽ ra từ nét ngắn sang nét dài và giữ nguyên.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio checkbox-stroke, written here): In a 2.2 s loop: the box fill #182231 → #75e4d2 and border #536277 → #75e4d2 over 12-30 % (0.26-0.66 s) cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1); then the check path M31 59 L40 68 L58 47 (short arm first) draws, dashoffset 1 → 0 over 28-53 % (0.62-1.17 s); holds checked. Label 'Save preference' static. Params: fill (0.4 s) · draw (0.55 s) · color (#75e4d2) · ease (power2.inOut). The box fills first (0.26–0.66 s), then the tick draws short arm first (0.62–1.17 s), both cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1); it holds checked.
